title: Grateful Dead Live at Greensboro Coliseum on 1991-04-01
lineage: mac > Yamaha K-98 > Edirol R09 HR > 24/48 wav > Adobe Audition > Wavelab 6 (with iZotope Ozone 4) > iZotope RX Advanced > 16/44.1 wav > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16 taped from OTS, and transferred by John Bleich
source: Source: Audience recording > Nakamichi 300s (with cp1 caps) > Sony WM-D6 > mac

ai_review.summary: Clear mix highlighted by a dramatic Jerry solo and a superb set with Riders, Dark Star and Bird Song from the Bruce Hornsby era.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clean balance – especially a moment where Jerry’s solo is turned up dramatically, giving it extra impact. Musically the show shines with Garcia in top form on Riders, a beautiful Dark Star and an extended 16‑minute Bird Song, all enhanced by Bruce Hornsby’s jazzy keyboards. Overall both performance and sound are viewed very positively.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give 4‑5 stars, highlighting strong playing and a good mix with no complaints; the modest number of reviews yields medium confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No issues reported; one reviewer notes Jerry’s solo is turned up dramatically and sounds great, indicating a clear and well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as a great, jazzy show from the Bruce Hornsby period with strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solo is highlighted for being turned up dramatically and his playing on Riders is praised.
band_member_comments.Keys: Bruce Hornsby’s contribution adds a jazzy flavor that reviewers appreciate.
